about: #886 golden fixture: what a real Claude Code 2.1.280 sends a channel MCP server, and what it consumes back. Captured 2026-09-22 from a live, isolated run (the bridge's stdio frames, scratch config, dummy API key, scripted model endpoint). The consumer half is read from the Claude Code 2.1.280 binary; the gate half is the list of reasons that binary logs when it skips a channel server.

params.meta: optional record of string to string

gate.capability: experimental["claude/channel"] in the initialize result, else: server did not declare claude/channel capability
gate.protocolVersion: not the modern revision 2026-07-28, else: connection negotiated a modern protocol revision with no unsolicited notification path
